meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在本地校验基因组区间数据并规划分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组区间研究,需要在校验数据后规划模型运行
copy.tagline_en: Validate genomic interval data locally and plan analysis runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on genomic intervals and need validated, planned analysis runs

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会围绕 BED 基因组区间数据做机器学习流程:校验 BED 与 universe 参数、规划 Region2Vec 或 scEmbed 训练、检查模型与 tokenizer 是否兼容、评估 consensus universe,并给出代码或命令行步骤。
howto.when: 当你要处理 BED 文件集合、scATAC-seq 数据等基因组区间数据,做区域嵌入、共识 peak(universe)构建或模型兼容性检查时接管。

say.text: 帮我把这批 BED 文件做 hard tokenization,并检查覆盖度。
say.note: 会给出 tokenization 步骤与覆盖度检查方法。

say.text: 用 CC 方法从这些 BED 文件构建 universe 并评估质量。
say.note: 会给出 build cc 与 evaluate 的命令。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude handles BED genomic-interval ML: validating BED and universe contracts, planning Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, checking model/tokenizer compatibility, and assessing consensus universes, returning code or CLI steps.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you work with BED file collections or scATAC-seq data for region embeddings, consensus peak (universe) building, or compatibility checks.

say_en.text: Hard-tokenize this set of BED files and check coverage.
say_en.note: Gives tokenization steps and a coverage check.

say_en.text: Plan a Region2Vec run with embedding_dim at 100.
say_en.note: Lists the training command and parameters.

say_en.text: Build a universe from these BED files with CC and evaluate it.
say_en.note: Gives the build cc and evaluate commands.
